    <style>
        body {
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
            display: flex;

            align-items: center;
            background-color: #f5f5f5;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 20px;
        }
        h1 {
            color: #333;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        canvas {
            background-color: white;
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            margin: 20px 0;

        .container {
            width: 800px;

<body>
    <div class="container">
        <h1>7-Day CPU Temperature Readings</h1>
        <canvas id="temperatureChart" width="800" height="400"></canvas>
    </div>

    <script>
        const ctx = document.getElementById('temperatureChart').getContext('2d');
        const temperatureChart = new Chart(ctx, {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
                labels: ['Day 1', 'Day 2', 'Day 3', 'Day 4', 'Day 5', 'Day 6', 'Day 7'],
                datasets: [{
                    label: 'CPU Temperature (°C)',
                    data: [55, 60, 45, 70, 50, 65, 75], // Sample data between 40-85
                    borderColor: 'rgb(255, 99, 132)',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 99, 132, 0.1)',
                    tension: 0.3,
                    borderWidth: 2,
                    pointBackgroundColor: 'rgb(255, 99, 132)',
                    pointRadius: 5,
                    pointHoverRadius: 7
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: false,
                scales: {
                    y: {
                        beginAtZero: false,
                        min: 40,
                        max: 85,
                        title: {
                            display: true,
                            text: 'Temperature (°C)'
                        },
                        ticks: {
                            stepSize: 5
                        }
                    },
                    x: {
                        title: {
                            display: true,
                            text: 'Day'
                        }
                    }
                },
                plugins: {
                    legend: {
                        display: true,
                        position: 'top'
                    },
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: function(context) {
                                return `${context.dataset.label}: ${context.raw}°C`;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>
